name: AI Post Summarizer Lite for WordPress
author: R.Sabbir

sections.description:
Unlock the power of AI on your blog with AI Post Summarizer Lite. Provide your readers with instant, high-quality AI TL;DR summaries and concise content overviews powered by ChatGPT and Google AI (SGE). Increase dwell time, improve SEO, and boost engagement by offering a modern, one-click content summarization experience.

Get ahead of the competition by integrating the latest AI technology directly into your workflow. Our lightweight solution is designed for maximum speed and zero server load, working seamlessly with your theme’s design. Offer your audience a premium reading experience that makes your content more accessible and digestible.

The included button is fully responsive and designed to look great on any device or theme. Give your readers a new way to interact with your content and see why AI-powered blogs are more dynamic and engaging.

Get AI Post Summarizer Pro – 50% OFF!

Features

  • One-Click Summaries: Let users summarize any post instantly with their preferred AI tool.
  • ChatGPT & Google AI: Native support for the world’s most popular AI models.
  • GDPR Compliant & Private: No user data is collected, stored, or transmitted.
  • Fully Responsive: The summary button looks great on all devices, from desktops to smartphones.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for performance with minimal impact on your site’s speed.
  • Display Settings: Simple options to control the position and appearance of the summary button.
  • Floating Action Button: Instant access to AI summaries from anywhere on the post.
  • UI/UX Overhaul: Premium dashboard experience with a bold new header and refined layout.
  • Mega Sale: Get 50% OFF on all Pro features and extensions for a limited time!
  • Enhanced Flexibility: Optimized user-experience for a smoother, more flexible workflow.
  • Translation Ready: Full internationalization support.

How It Works

The plugin adds a summary button to your posts. When a visitor clicks it, the plugin intelligently creates a special link that opens a new tab to their favorite AI service (like ChatGPT) with a pre-filled prompt asking it to summarize the content of your post. The entire process happens in the user’s browser, ensuring privacy and zero server load.

Benefits

  • Save Your Readers’ Time: Long articles can be intimidating. A summary gives readers the key takeaways instantly.
  • Boost User Engagement: Providing a useful tool like this keeps users on your site longer and encourages interaction.
  • Modernize Your Website: Show your audience that your site is on the cutting edge of technology.
  • Increase Content Accessibility: Summaries can help users with learning disabilities or those who are short on time.

AI Post Summarizer Pro

For the ultimate toolkit, AI Post Summarizer Pro is available for those who need more power. The Pro version is a massive upgrade designed for power users, marketers, and businesses.

Key Pro Features:
* 6+ AI Platforms (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
* Advanced Design Engine (Live Preview, 20+ styles)
* Smart Prompt Library (Build and save templates)
* Built-in Analytics Dashboard (Track engagement)
* Priority Support

Unlock AI Post Summarizer Pro & Get 50% OFF!

Privacy Policy

AI Post Summarizer Lite does not:
* Collect, track, or store any personal data from your visitors.
* Use cookies or any tracking scripts.
* Transmit any data from your site to our servers or any third parties.

All processing happens locally in the user’s browser. This plugin is fully GDPR compliant and respects user privacy.

Technical Specifications

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Performance

  • Loading: Conditionally loads assets only on single post pages.
  • HTTP Requests: Zero external HTTP requests are made by the plugin.
  • Code Size: The plugin is extremely lightweight with a minimal footprint.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “AI Post Summarizer Lite”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to the AI Summarizer menu in your dashboard to access Settings & Customization.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the file you downloaded.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
sections.faq:
1. How does this plugin work without an API key?

The plugin constructs a special link. When a user clicks the button, it opens their chosen AI tool in a new browser tab and passes in the instruction to summarize your article’s content.

2. Is this plugin really free to use?

Yes, 100% free. Because it works client-side, there are no API costs for you to worry about.

3. Can I change the style or position of the button?

Yes, the Lite version includes settings to adjust the button’s position and appearance to best fit your theme.

4. What is the difference between the Lite and Pro versions?

The Lite version offers summaries via popular AI platforms. The Pro version is a complete toolkit supporting 6+ AI platforms, an Advanced Design Engine, and a Smart Prompt Library.

5. Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress best practices to ensure maximum compatibility with all popular themes.

6. Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes! The plugin works seamlessly with all major caching solutions because of its client-side nature.

7. Does this use my server’s resources to generate summaries?

No. The plugin is 100% client-side and puts zero load on your web server.

8. How can I get the Pro version and the 50% discount?

You can unlock all advanced features and claim your limited-time 50% discount by visiting the official AI Post Summarizer Pro page. Once purchased, you’ll receive instant access to premium AI models, advanced design tools, and priority support.
